senses.definitionEn: Used to show what someone or something is, or to indicate existence.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: She is a very talented doctor.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Ella es una doctora muy talentosa.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: To be successful in this industry requires persistent dedication.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Ser exitoso en esta industria requiere dedicación constante.

phrasalVerbs.example1: I will be back in five minutes.
phrasalVerbs.example2: When will you be back from London?
The storm was over by morning.

senses.definitionEn: Used to connect words, phrases, or clauses together.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Me gustan las manzanas y los plátanos.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: He analyzed the data and presented his findings to the board.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Analizó los datos y presentó sus hallazgos a la junta.

senses.definitionEn: Used to show belonging, connection, or relation between things.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: This is the capital city of France.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Esta es la capital de Francia.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: The core of the problem lies in poor communication.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: El núcleo del problema radica en una mala comunicación.

senses.definitionEn: Used to indicate direction, destination, or a point reached.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: We are going to the supermarket.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: She dedicated her entire career to scientific research.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Ella dedicó toda su carrera a la investigación científica.

senses.definitionEn: Used before a verb to indicate the infinitive form.

graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: It is essential to understand the underlying principles.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Es esencial comprender los principios subyacentes.

senses.definitionEn: Used before countable nouns when mentioning them for the first time or not specifying a particular one.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: I saw a cat in the garden.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Vi un gato en el jardín.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: Establishing a strong foundation requires time and patience.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: Establecer una base sólida requiere tiempo y paciencia.

senses.contextualHint: ubicación dentro de un espacio o contenedor
senses.definitionEn: Inside or within a space, place, or period of time.

graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEn: My keys are in the bag.
graduatedExamples.sentenceBasicEs: Mis llaves están en el bolso.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEn: The discovery resulted in a major breakthrough in medicine.
graduatedExamples.sentenceAdvancedEs: El descubrimiento resultó en un gran avance en la medicina.
